scenes.heading: ASK YOUR *WHATSAPP* ANYTHING
scenes.sub: WhatsApp MCP · your chats, searchable by AI
scenes.say: That address someone sent you last March is buried in WhatsApp. Now your AI can dig it out.

scenes.heading: MEET *WHATSAPP MCP*
scenes.say: This is WhatsApp MCP, a read only bridge that lets your agent search your own messages.

scenes.heading: HOW IT *WORKS*
scenes.say: Link your phone once, then ask in plain words. It searches every chat, reads the one you mean, and answers without sending anything.

scenes.heading: DEVS *NOTICED*
scenes.say: It passed two hundred and fifty stars within its first day.

scenes.heading: *DEPLOY YOUR OWN*
scenes.say: You deploy it into your own Cloudflare account, scan a code with your phone, and connect your agent.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *LINK IT*
cons: Unofficial: against WhatsApp's terms, so the risk is not zero
Importing history needs the paid Workers plan
pros: Read only: it cannot send messages
Your messages stay in your own account
scenes.say: The honest catch: this is unofficial, it runs against WhatsApp's terms, so the risk is not zero, and importing history needs the paid Workers plan. In return, it can only read, never send, and your messages stay in your own account.
What would you ask your own WhatsApp first? Comment Search and follow for tools like this.

youtube.title: WhatsApp MCP: Your AI Can Now Search Your Own Chats
youtube.description:
WhatsApp MCP is a read-only MCP server that lets Claude Code and other AI agents search and read your own WhatsApp history — full-text search across every chat, deployed into your own Cloudflare account. The honest catches are in the video: it is unofficial (against WhatsApp's terms, low but non-zero risk) and importing history needs the Workers Paid plan. 256 GitHub stars in its first day.
Source: https://github.com/finereli/whatsapp-mcp
